column7: F3a: RBACHandler.replaceRolePermissions (server/http/handlers/rbac.go) swallowed every storage error from RemovePermissionFromRole/AssignPermissionToRole and UpdateRole always replied 200 regardless; found by FuzzStorageFaultOperations's own seed corpus (predicted from code review, then confirmed live). Fixed by making core.UpdateRole run the role-row update and the permission-set replacement inside one storage.WithTransaction, propagating any failure as an error; both REST and gRPC now call this single function. Proving test is the fuzz harness itself, not a dedicated point test -- its seed corpus is the permanent regression, no KNOWN-OPEN tolerance remains; see docs/findings/2026-09-21-FINDING-role-update-permission-replace-swallows-storage-errors.md
